items.name: Dovluru T.E.
items.text: It is important that the studio’s team is always in touch, takes responsibility for their promises and actions, and works quickly and in an organized manner. items.name: Ekaterina L.
items.text: We have been working with Indevix for over a year. During this time, they created several landing pages, presentations, and even a logo for us. Always in touch, always ready to help and advise. I like that they don’t offer template solutions—they really think through the task and propose options that fit us best.

items.name: Aleksey S.
items.text: Very satisfied with our cooperation with Indevix. We ordered a landing page and presentation design. Everything was done quickly, with high quality, and with all requirements considered. The team is always available and ready to help with any questions. Recommended!
